name: Acquisition Management Support III
description:
Are you looking for your next challenge? Are you ready to work with a performance-based small company? At Zantech, we are a dynamic Woman Owned Small Business focused on providing complex, mission-focused solutions with a proven track record of outstanding customer performance and high employee satisfaction. We would love to talk with you regarding the next step in your career. Come join our team!

Zantech is looking for a talented Acquisition Management Support III to contribute to the success of our upcoming Logistics and Sustainment Support Services contract for an Onsite role based out of Aberdeen Proving Ground (APG), Maryland.

The Acquisition Management Support III will play a crucial role in providing acquisition program management and analysis for planning and execution of federal programs at different ACAT levels and all program life cycle phases through understanding of DoDI 5000.02, acquisition streamlining initiatives, and performance metrics analysis.

The Acquisition Management Support III   will provide acquisition advice, reviews program documentation, coordinates approval tracking, partners in efficiency initiatives, provide POM/WSR expertise, reviews program progress, and supports knowledge management. Impact: Ensures acquisition excellence and regulatory compliance across programs.

Responsibilities include, but will not be limited to:

  • Provide acquisition advice based on comprehensive knowledge of principles, policies, laws, and regulatory requirements
  • Review and provide guidance for program documentation updates per U.S. Code Title 10, DoDD 5000.01, DoDI 5000.02, AR 70-1
  • Coordinate, identify, prepare, review, and track approval of Acquisition Strategy Reports, APBs, and ADMs for MDRs
  • Partner with clients in Army and DoD efficiency, cost saving, and continuous process improvement initiatives
  • Support Better Buying Power efforts including Will/Should Cost initiatives
  • Support Lean Six Sigma projects, Value Engineering initiatives, Business Process Reengineering efforts
  • Provide strategic programmatic integration expertise for POM Reviews and WSRs
  • Review and analyze program progress and fund utilization reports
  • Identify areas where programs are not progressing as planned (cost, schedule, performance)
  • Review Acquisition Requirements Packages (ARPs)
  • Reviewing and modify policies, guidance, and procedures in program management, acquisition, cost, and efficiencies
  • Address applicability and relevance of OSD and ASA(ALT) requirements
  • Support knowledge management efforts: create, share, use, and manage CPE knowledge
  • Ensure identification, documentation, mapping and understanding of CPE practices, methods and processes
  • Ensure identification, handling, accumulation, assessment and sharing of lessons learned
  • Ensure identification, documentation, collection and sharing of SME knowledge and information
  • Prepare and review reports for senior level management
  • Work with Program/Product managers and DoA Systems Coordinators to ensure programs have required acquisition documentation
  • Ensure CPE inquiries and directives are carried out including periodic reviews, monitoring, and lessons learned

Required Experience or Knowledge of the following technologies/functions:

  • Experience across multiple acquisition phases required
  • Understanding of POM and WSR processes required
  • Industry standard for Acquisition Management Support III: 10+ years of DoD acquisition program management experience across multiple ACATs and life cycle phases.
  • Experience providing:
  • Acquisition advice based on comprehensive knowledge of principles/policies/laws/regulations
  • Reviewing and guiding program documentation updates per Title 10/DoDD 5000.01/DoDI 5000.02/AR 70-1,
  • Coordinating and tracking program documentation (Acquisition Strategy Reports, APBs, ADMs) for MDRs
  • Partnering in efficiency initiatives (Better Buying Power, Will/Should Cost, Lean Six Sigma, Value Engineering, Business Process Reengineering)
  • Providing POM/WSR expertise
  • Reviewing  program progress and fund utilization reports, reviewing ARPs, working on CPE policies/guidance/procedures, and supporting knowledge management.
  • Industry standard technical skills: DoDI 5000.02 expertise, Acquisition Strategy development, APB creation, milestone documentation, Better Buying Power initiatives, Lean Six Sigma.

Preferred Education/Certifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or related field (Industry standard)
  • Master's degree in relevant field (Industry standard)
  • DAWIA Program Management Level III (Industry standard)
  • DAWIA Life Cycle Logistics Level III (Industry standard)
  • PMP (Industry standard)
  • Lean Six Sigma certification (Industry standard)

Required Security Clearance:

  • US Citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain an active Secret trust or higher clearance, per contract requirements.

“Outstanding Performance…Always!”

Our corporate motto represents our commitment to build long-term relationships with both our clients and our employees by providing the highest quality service in everything we do. We strive for excellence for our clients and for each other. We embrace the opportunity to hire individuals with new talents and fresh perspectives. Zantech offers competitive compensation, strong benefits, and a vacation package, as well as a fast-paced and exciting work environment. Come join our team!

name: Chief Enterprise Architect
description:

Zantech is looking for a talented Chief Enterprise Architect to contribute to the success of our upcoming Technical Infrastructure and Platform Support project for an On-Site role based out of Arlington, VA.

The Chief Enterprise Architect will play a crucial role in providing:

  • Data Acquisition, Analytics, and Governance Services (data ecosystem design and integration)
  • Technical Infrastructure and Platform Support (cloud architecture, scalability) - PWS Section 5.1 text references "Sections 4.3 and 4.5"; confirm intended cross-reference against PWS Section 4 numbering
  • PMP Technical Roadmap and Future-Proofing & Tech Horizon Parity Plan (architectural input)
  • Cybersecurity and Information Assurance (Zero Trust Architecture alignment)

The Chief Enterprise Architect serves as the ultimate technical authority for the design, scalability, and integration of the entire data and analytics ecosystem (the Data and Analytics Portal), ensuring the architecture meets all requirements and supports the modular, open-architecture Future-Proofing & Tech Horizon Parity Plan required in the PMP.

Responsibilities include, but will not be limited to:

  • Own end-to-end architecture for the D&A ecosystem, including scalability and integration decisions
  • Lead ETL/ELT and OLAP/OLTP system design across legacy and modernized components
  • Create and maintain formal architecture documentation (system views, technical roadmaps)
  • Guide modular, loosely coupled, open-architecture design to prevent vendor lock-in (PWS Section 9.0)
  • Support Zero Trust and FedRAMP High / DoD IL5-compliant architecture decisions

Required Experience or Knowledge of the following technologies/functions:

  • Ten (10)+ years designing scalable, secure, resilient enterprise-level systems, including at least 5 years focused specifically on data-intensive solutions in a cloud environment; 5 years hands-on data modeling experience (logical and physical models).
  • Skills Required:
    •  Enterprise/solution architecture for cloud-based data and analytics platforms
    • Data modeling (logical and physical) and ETL/ELT integration architecture
    • OLAP and OLTP system design
    • Formal architecture documentation (system views, technical roadmaps) for a complex data ecosystem
    • DoD Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) alignment

Required Education/Certifications:

  • Education Required:
    • MA/MS degree and 10+ years of experience (Senior/Lead tier)
  • BA/BS with 12+ years of experience is an accepted substitute
  • Education Preferred:  
    • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field
  • Professional-level cloud architect certification (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert)
  • TOGAF or equivalent enterprise architecture certification
  • Certifications Required:
  • Certifications Preferred:

Required Security Clearance:

  • US Citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain an active Secret or higher clearance, per contract requirements.

name: Cloud Programs Analyst - Technical Background
description:
Are you looking for your next challenge? Are you ready to work with a performance-based small company? At Zantech, we are a dynamic Woman Owned Small Business focused on providing complex, mission-focused solutions with a proven track record of outstanding customer performance and high employee satisfaction. We would love to talk with you regarding the next step in your career. Come join our team!

Zantech is looking for a Cloud Programs Communications Analyst to support a federal IT modernization program for a major civilian agency in the Washington, DC Metro area. This is a hybrid role for someone who thrives at the intersection of technology and communication - someone who understands how cloud infrastructure and IT modernization programs work, and whose greatest strength is translating that complexity into sharp, polished materials for senior government leaders.

This is not a deep technical hands-on role. It is a high-visibility communications and analytical support role. If you are energized by the challenge of walking into a room of senior executives with a crisp brief you built from raw program data - this position is for you.

What You Will Do:

  • Develop and deliver executive-level briefings, talking points, status reports, and presentations for senior federal leadership audiences (think C-suite equivalent government officials)
  • Translate complex cloud migration and IT modernization program activity into clear, concise executive narratives using PowerPoint, Word, and Excel
  • Support cloud schedule tracking and reporting, turning data into visual dashboards and program summaries that inform leadership decisions
  • Respond rapidly to ad-hoc data calls and tasking requests from government leads
  • Coordinate with technical team members to gather, synthesize, and accurately represent program status, risks, and accomplishments
  • Manage program documentation, action item tracking, and recurring reporting cadences
  • Support development of talking points and materials for external government conferences and interagency engagements
  • Maintain knowledge management content using Microsoft 365 collaboration tools

What You Must Bring:

  • 3–5 years of experience in a role where producing polished briefings, reports, or executive communications was central - not occasional
  • The ability to absorb technical information quickly and retell it clearly to a non-technical audience - this is the job
  • Strong command of Microsoft 365, particularly PowerPoint, Word, and Excel; you should be able to build a compelling executive slide deck without a template
  • Excellent verbal communication and presentation skills; you are comfortable presenting your work to senior stakeholders
  • Active DHS/CBP High Public Trust (Background Investigation Level 4 or 5) OR an active DoD Top Secret clearance - one of these is required; we cannot sponsor or wait on clearance processing for this position

What Will Make You Stand Out:

  • Experience supporting federal IT programs, cloud migration initiatives, or government IT modernization efforts
  • Familiarity with cloud concepts and terminology (AWS, Azure, or similar) - you don't need to build the architecture, but you should be able to read a cloud migration report and know what it means
  • AWS Cloud Practitioner certification or active pursuit of one is a genuine plus
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI
  • Background in a consulting or advisory environment where you regularly prepared materials for senior decision-makers

What We Are Not Looking For:

  • A hands-on cloud engineer or infrastructure architect - there are other positions for that
  • Someone who has "excellent communication skills" because it was listed on their last JD - we want someone who can show it

Required Security Clearance:
U.S. Citizenship required. Must currently hold an active DHS/CBP High Public Trust (BI Level 4 or 5) or an active DoD Top Secret clearance. This is a non-negotiable requirement.
